description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that delivers Express‑level simplicity at edge‑scale speed with built‑in AI hooks and native serverless deployment.
npm_trending_strategy: v0.0.111‑daily adds a first‑class AI‑hook API, native TypeScript typings that require no compilation step, and a built‑in edge‑runtime that runs on Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy and Bun with zero‑config. By eliminating all runtime dependencies and bundling security best‑practices (CSP, rate‑limiting, helmet‑like headers) out‑of‑the‑box, it outperforms Express and Fastify on cold‑start latency while offering a developer‑friendly, type‑safe router that auto‑generates OpenAPI specs. This makes the package a magnet for the 2026 “AI‑first, edge‑first” development wave.
download_hooks: Lightning‑fast cold starts (<5 ms) on edge runtimes – perfect for serverless APIs.
Type‑safe routing with auto‑generated OpenAPI & GraphQL schemas eliminates boilerplate.
Built‑in AI‑hooks let you attach LLM‑driven middleware without extra packages.
